title: Japan commemorates end of war with Takaichi avoiding Yasukuni and without mentioning 'reflection' in tribute to fallen
summary: At the ceremony for the 80th anniversary of the end of World War II, the prime minister omitted the words 'reflection' and 'promise not to repeat the war,' while several ministers visited Yasukuni Shrine and the emperor expressed his 'deep remorse.'

title: 健大高崎 defeats 佐野日大 in historic Gunma-Tochigi duel and advances to Koshien quarterfinals
summary: The Gunma team achieved its first victory in this matchup of representatives from the two prefectures and reached the quarterfinals for the first time in 12 years.

title: 仙台育英 beats 拓大紅陵 and reaches Koshien quarterfinals despite rain
summary: Sendai Ikuei dominated with seven hits in the first two innings and withstood the rain delay, while the opposing team could not count on 70 cheering students due to the floods.

title: Japan secures Olympic spot at Rhythmic Gymnastics World Championships and Balfolomeev wins her third title
summary: The Japanese group finished second in the team event and obtained the first spot for Los Angeles 2028, while individual Balfolomeev was crowned for the third time.

title: British 12-year-old girl missing in Japan found safe and sound
summary: The girl went alone to a Yokohama police station and was located without incident.

title: Kumamoto earthquake leaves more than 30,000 homes damaged and reveals failures in emergency aid
summary: A new assessment raised residential damage figures and a report pointed out deficiencies in water supply and emergency toilets.

title: Torrential rains in Chiba cause flooding, submerged cars, and water outages
summary: The intense rainfall during the Obon period generated more than 2,000 tow truck requests, areas still flooded, and families without drinking water.
